summary: Transform your understanding of land restoration and soil health. Sign up for our expert-led training course and help foster a healthier planet!
lede: Land restoration and soil health management helps land and environmental practitioners diagnose degraded sites and plan practical recovery work. The course is for professionals working with soils, restoration, or environmental compliance who need to assess soil condition, select interventions, and monitor results. Learners practise mapping degradation, planning measures such as erosion control and organic matter recovery, and setting indicators for tracking soil recovery.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who already work with land, soils, restoration, or environmental compliance and need practical methods they can use immediately.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of agriculture, ecology, environmental management, or land use operations; no coding required. You should already understand basic field terminology such as erosion, infiltration, organic matter, and site survey notes. Familiarity with soil sampling, restoration projects, or sustainable land management is helpful but not mandatory. The course assumes intermediate-level professional experience and focuses on applied land restoration and soil health management rather than introductory soil science.
